title: xAI Launches Grok Bot: Provide AI Agents with a Dedicated Cloud Computer, Not a Chat Tool
excerpt: xAI launched the beta version of Grok Bot, positioned as a "permanent AI agent team": each agent has its own cloud computer, can log into users' existing tools,
content_html:
xAI launched the beta version of Grok Bot, positioned as a "permanent AI agent team": each agent has its own cloud computer, can log into users' existing tools, and independently complete multi-step tasks without supervision. Unlike previous automation processes that required users to issue step-by-step commands, the core design of Grok Bot allows agents to work like human employees - even if you turn off your laptop, the task will continue in the cloud, and it will only return to you when approval is needed.

Users can communicate with the Bot via desktop or iOS, just like sending messages to a colleague. They can also demonstrate a workflow on the spot for the Bot to learn, after which it will save the steps and automatically repeat the execution. Multiple Bots can run in parallel, send messages to each other, share discussion threads, and even assign and claim tasks within work chat groups. xAI describes this as a "team with a supervisor," not a pile of automated tools that users need to manage manually. xAI revealed that the product initially started as an internal prototype, with teams such as sales outreach, marketing campaigns, office operations, and bug fixes already using it.

Selling the product bundled, not as a standalone

Grok Bot's business approach is quite unique: it is not sold separately but bundled into three existing paid subscription tiers. Cursor Ultra costs $200 per month, including a dedicated computer for the Bot, tool access, scheduled tasks, and desktop and mobile access; Cursor Premium Teams costs $120 per seat per month, offering additional features such as centralized billing, a team skills marketplace, and enterprise single sign-on; xAI's top-tier SuperGrok Heavy subscribers directly get Grok Bot, and enterprise customers are currently on a waiting list.

This strategy of "embedding agents into users' existing paid subscriptions" has lower costs than selling seats from scratch, and it deeply ties xAI's agent strategy to Cursor. The download, setup, guidance process, and sales integration are all handled through Cursor's infrastructure, making the product stacks of both companies visibly intertwined on the launch day. Internal use cases within xAI point to a market proposition: agents with dedicated computers can "take on a role" rather than just assist with a task. Sales outreach Bots can research clients overnight and draft emails in the salesperson's tone, demo-ready Bots check the environment in advance and fix bad data, and Bots handle CRM record organization, invoice processing, helping new employees onboard, and reproducing bugs before handing them over to debugging Bots - these tasks usually correspond to those of a junior or operational staff member, while the Grok Bot subscription price is far below the cost of a full-time salary. An Android app is planned for the future, and enterprise access continues to be available through a waiting list.

content_html_zh:
xAI推出了Grok Bot的测试版，定位为“永久AI代理团队”：每个代理都有自己的云计算机，可以登录用户现有的工具，在无人监督的情况下独立完成多步骤任务。 与之前需要用户发出逐步命令的自动化流程不同，Grok Bot 的核心设计允许代理像人类员工一样工作——即使你关闭笔记本电脑，任务也会在云端继续进行，并且只有在需要批准时才会返回给你。

用户可以通过桌面或iOS与Bot进行通信，就像向同事发送消息一样。 他们还可以现场演示工作流程供机器人学习，之后机器人会保存步骤并自动重复执行。 多个机器人可以并行运行、相互发送消息、共享讨论线程，甚至在工作聊天组中分配和领取任务。 xAI 将其描述为“有主管的团队”，而不是用户需要手动管理的一堆自动化工具。 xAI 透露，该产品最初是作为内部原型开始的，销售外展、营销活动、办公室运营和错误修复等团队已经在使用它。

捆绑销售产品，而不是作为独立产品

Grok Bot 的业务方式非常独特：它不单独出售，而是捆绑到现有的三个付费订阅层中。 Cursor Ultra 每月费用为 200 美元，包括用于 Bot 的专用计算机、工具访问、计划任务以及桌面和移动访问； Cursor Premium Teams 每个席位每月 120 美元，提供集中计费、团队技能市场和企业单点登录等附加功能； xAI 的顶级 SuperGrok Heavy 订户可直接获得 Grok Bot，企业客户目前正在等待名单上。

这种“将代理嵌入到用户现有付费订阅中”的策略比从头开始销售席位的成本更低，并且将 xAI 的代理策略与 Cursor 紧密联系在一起。 下载、设置、指导过程和销售集成都是通过 Cursor 的基础设施处理的，这使得两家公司的产品堆栈在发布当天就明显地交织在一起。 xAI 的内部用例指出了一个市场主张：拥有专用计算机的代理可以“承担一个角色”，而不仅仅是协助完成任务。 销售推广机器人可以连夜研究客户并以销售人员的语气起草电子邮件，准备演示的机器人可以提前检查环境并修复不良数据，机器人可以处理 CRM 记录组织、发票处理、帮助新员工入职以及在将其交给调试机器人之前重现错误 - 这些任务通常对应于初级或运营人员的任务，而 Grok Bot 订阅价格远低于全职工资的成本。 未来计划推出 Android 应用程序，并继续通过等待名单提供企业访问权限。
